title: T7 — Change control (retrospective, 2026-11-24)
body:
# T7 — Change control (retrospective, 2026-11-24)

## Change requests

| Change | Title | Status |
|---|---|---|
| CHG-T7-1 | Accept the T7 deliverables with their evidence | approved |

The six deliverables are complete against the frozen scope baseline; the change authorises
recording their acceptance and evidence on the WBS rows.

## Impact

- Scope: WBS deliverables 1–6 — accepted with evidence, no scope change.
- Baseline: the frozen scope baseline is unchanged.
- Schedule and cost: no change; this records delivered scope.

## Decisions

- Approved by the distinct approver `01a1e8a7-8b23-76a9-9114-aafb95f7a545` under the published standing delegation,
  recorded on the change row's `meta.approved_by`.
- The approved change is the authority the WBS acceptance reads.

## Deliverables accepted under this change

| # | Deliverable | Business value | Time criticality | Risk reduction | Job size | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Incidents are opened and triaged on the board from the operations queue | 9 | 8 | 7 | 2 | accepted |
| 2 | Runbooks and postmortems are governed documents linked to the incident | 8 | 7 | 6 | 2 | accepted |
| 3 | The four write verbs are callable and read back; an undeclared verb is refused | 9 | 8 | 8 | 3 | accepted |
| 4 | A destructive call without the tenant's configured approvals is refused | 9 | 7 | 9 | 2 | accepted |
| 5 | An approved mitigation sets mitigated_at with a read-back | 8 | 7 | 7 | 2 | accepted |
| 6 | Hosts are registered before use and a systemic finding opens exactly one kata | 7 | 6 | 6 | 2 | accepted |
